title: Fletcher Henderson's band in Kansas City, December 1933
summary: He recalls Fletcher Henderson's band visiting with Coleman Hawkins, Bobby Stark and Dickie Wells, and going around with Stark.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: 1933, because December 18th, 1933, I will never forget Fletcher Henderson's band coming to Kansas City and Herschel Evans and Lester Young with Ben Webster at the Cherry Blossoms Ballroom, when Coleman Hawkins got drunk and Dickie Wells was right there and laughed at him.
A great player. Because of his trombone playing.
Yes and I walked in with Bobby Stark.
Bobby Stark worked with Fletcher then?
Coleman was with Fletcher. Because Coleman left to go to St. Joe 75 miles to see his mother. [Joseph, Missouri]
That's right, he's from St. Joe. Let's check that band out with Fletcher. Who did Fletcher bring in that band out there in 1933? There was Coleman Hawkins -
As far as I know. I hung out with Bobby because you know I was -
Trumpet player. I said, Bobby, come on and go with me. I took him in a cab. The cab was only 15¢.
There was Coleman Hawkins and Bobby Stark.
